The filer conflates 'the bin with maximum energy' (argmax) with 'a spectral peak' (local maximum above threshold with minimum-separation constraints). The global maximum of a spectrum is not the same construct as a spectral peak: the former is O(N) scan, the latter involves thresholding and local analysis. Removal of the spectral-peak construct does not stop PAR from operating. DEPENDS_ON fails.
